scope: Retrospective replication of two documented 1955 observations of 137108; not new astrometry
author_check: Automated local pixel reduction and control checks; see review/validation.json
open_obligations: Resolve archive DATE-OBS versus published trail-end times against original observing/plate logs.
Independently reduce both native image cutouts with a separate method and inspect all blends and plate artifacts.
Audit centroid covariance, correlated photographic noise, systematic floors and timing uncertainty.
Review Gaia propagation, proper-motion systematics, reference-star selection and local WCS residuals.
Check other moving-object confusers; the small catalogue check covers stationary sources, not every asteroid.
Increase documented controls and negative samples before estimating population false-alarm rates.
For new observations, perform appropriate independent linkage/orbit checks; JPL#100 already uses these controls.
Obtain a consenting scientific maintainer and actual review capacity before opening donor work.
Any future ADES formatting/submission requires separate scientific review and authorization.

decisions.decision: Replication screen only; cannot accept science
